prediction_source: The evaluated snapshot must agree with each model's *_merged_runs.json after canonicalization.

similarity.definition: mean Morgan-fingerprint Tanimoto similarity over all valid predictions, including exact matches

rmsce.binning: equal-width intervals ((m-1)/10, m/10], with confidence 0 included in the first bin
rmsce.definition: root-mean-square confidence calibration error against structural similarity

formula_conservation.definition: valid predictions whose RDKit molecular formula matches the reference formula / valid predictions
